Route 1's construction of the SU(5) hypercharge generator and the SO(10)/SU(5) branching of the E6 27 relies on citing the 'standard E6 group theory' branching pattern (labelled CITED in the script's own docstring) as the starting scaffold before checking it against a second route; the identification of which E6 weight-orbit direction is 'hypercharge' at all rests on matching to the known GUT branching shape rather than being forced by the object.
